This is a large shallow white bowl, probably about 24-26 cm across, holding a small pile of spinach leaves with shredded carrot and a light dressing. The pile looks like roughly 1.5 to 2 cups of loosely packed spinach, which is about 50 to 60 g. The carrot adds around 5 g and the dressing perhaps 5 to 10 g. That gives a total of about 65 g. Spinach is very low in energy at about 23 kcal per 100 g, so it contributes roughly 15 kcal. The carrot adds about 2 kcal. The leaves look slightly glossy, so I assume about a teaspoon of oil-based dressing, around 40 kcal. The total comes to roughly 55 to 60 kcal.
